// Nova AI backend. Hosts index.html and gives it a server:
// AI chat proxy (key stays on the server), web search, image generation.
// Setup: keep nova-server.js, package.json and index.html together in the same folder, then
//   npm install        (uses package.json)
//   LLM_KEY=... LLM_MODEL=... node nova-server.js
// Env: LLM_KEY, LLM_MODEL (required) | LLM_BASE (default OpenRouter, any OpenAI-compatible URL)
//      TAVILY_KEY (enables web search) | IMAGE_KEY, IMAGE_MODEL, IMAGE_BASE (enables images)
// Free-tier hosts such as Render or Railway can run this. Check each provider's current limits.
const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const E = process.env;
const BASE = E.LLM_BASE || 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1';
const app = express();
app.use(express.json({ limit: '6mb' }));

// Simple per-IP limit: 60 requests/minute
const hits = new Map();
app.use('/api', (q, r, next) => {
  const now = Date.now(), a = (hits.get(q.ip) || []).filter(t => now - t < 6e4);
  if (a.length >= 60) return r.status(429).json({ error: 'Too many requests' });
  a.push(now); hits.set(q.ip, a); next();
});

app.get('/api/config', (q, r) => {
  if (!E.LLM_KEY || !E.LLM_MODEL) return r.status(503).end();
  r.json({ model: E.LLM_MODEL, web: !!E.TAVILY_KEY, image: !E.IMAGE_OFF, stt: !E.STT_OFF });
});

// Speech to text for live voice when the phone browser cannot do it itself (same provider key, e.g. Groq Whisper).
app.post('/api/transcribe', express.raw({ type: () => true, limit: '8mb' }), async (q, r) => {
  try {
    if (!Buffer.isBuffer(q.body) || q.body.length < 800) return r.status(400).json({ error: 'No audio received' });
    const type = String(q.headers['content-type'] || 'audio/webm').split(';')[0];
    const ext = /mp4|m4a|aac/.test(type) ? 'm4a' : /ogg/.test(type) ? 'ogg' : /wav/.test(type) ? 'wav' : 'webm';
    const lang = String(q.query.lang || '').toLowerCase();
    let last = null;
    for (const model of [E.STT_MODEL || 'whisper-large-v3-turbo', 'whisper-large-v3']) {
      const f = new FormData();
      f.append('file', new Blob([q.body], { type }), 'speech.' + ext);
      f.append('model', model); f.append('response_format', 'json'); f.append('temperature', '0');
      if (/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(lang)) f.append('language', lang);
      const u = await fetch(BASE.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/audio/transcriptions', { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + E.LLM_KEY }, body: f });
      const text = await u.text();
      if (u.ok) { let j = {}; try { j = JSON.parse(text) } catch (e) {} return r.json({ text: String(j.text || '').trim() }); }
      last = { status: u.status, text };
      if (u.status !== 400 && u.status !== 404) break;
    }
    r.status(last.status).json({ error: 'Speech service said: ' + String(last.text).slice(0, 160) });
  } catch (e) { r.status(502).json({ error: 'Speech service unreachable' }); }
});


// Keep requests small (free tiers limit tokens per minute): last N messages, long old answers shortened.
const MAXMSG = Number(E.LLM_MAX_HISTORY) || 10;
function slim(body) {
  const m = Array.isArray(body.messages) ? body.messages : [];
  const sys = m.filter(x => x.role === 'system').slice(0, 1);
  const rest = m.filter(x => x.role !== 'system').slice(-MAXMSG).map((x, i, a) =>
    (x.role === 'assistant' && typeof x.content === 'string' && x.content.length > 1500 && i < a.length - 1)
      ? { ...x, content: x.content.slice(0, 1500) + ' ...' } : x);
  while (rest.length && rest[0].role === 'tool') rest.shift();
  return { ...body, messages: capImg([...sys, ...rest].map(flat)) };
}
// Text-only models need plain string content; vision models accept at most 3 images per request.
const isImg = p => p && p.type === 'image_url';
const flat = x => (Array.isArray(x.content) && !x.content.some(isImg)) ? { ...x, content: x.content.map(p => (p && p.text) || '').join('\n') } : x;
function capImg(msgs) {
  let n = 0;
  const out = msgs.slice();
  for (let i = out.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (!Array.isArray(out[i].content)) continue;
    out[i] = { ...out[i], content: out[i].content.map(p => isImg(p) ? (++n <= 3 ? p : { type: 'text', text: '[earlier image omitted]' }) : p) };
  }
  return out;
}
// Free tiers limit tokens per minute (Groq free: 8000). Keep every request under a token budget:
// drop the archive packs first, then the oldest messages, then shorten the middle of the system prompt.
const BUDGET = Number(E.LLM_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS) || 5000;
const VISION = E.LLM_VISION_MODEL || 'qwen/qwen3.8-27b';          // the only model that accepts photos
const VBUDGET = Number(E.LLM_VISION_BUDGET) || 6500;
const imgT = m => Array.isArray(m.content) ? m.content.filter(isImg).length * 2048 : 0;   // each image counts as 2048 tokens
const hasImg = b => (b.messages || []).some(m => imgT(m) > 0);
const txt = m => typeof m.content === 'string' ? m.content : (Array.isArray(m.content) ? m.content.map(p => (p && p.text) || '').join(' ') : '');
const est = s => { let a = 0, b = 0; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) (s.charCodeAt(i) < 128 ? a++ : b++); return a / 3.5 + b / 1.2; };
function fit(body, budget) {
  const m = Array.isArray(body.messages) ? body.messages.slice() : [];
  let sys = m.find(x => x.role === 'system');
  const rest = m.filter(x => x !== sys);
  const restT = () => rest.reduce((n, x) => n + est(txt(x)) + imgT(x) + 4, 0);
  const total = () => (sys ? est(txt(sys)) : 0) + restT();
  if (sys && typeof sys.content === 'string' && total() > budget)
    sys = { ...sys, content: sys.content.replace(/\[\[PACKS\]\][\s\S]*?\[\[\/PACKS\]\]/, '') };
  while (rest.length > 1 && total() > budget) rest.shift();
  while (rest.length && rest[0].role === 'tool') rest.shift();
  if (sys && typeof sys.content === 'string' && total() > budget) {
    const sysT = est(sys.content), want = Math.max(800, budget - restT());
    const keep = Math.max(1500, Math.floor(sys.content.length * want / sysT)), head = Math.floor(keep * 0.7);
    sys = { ...sys, content: sys.content.slice(0, head) + '\n...\n' + sys.content.slice(-(keep - head)) };
  }
  if (sys && typeof sys.content === 'string') sys = { ...sys, content: sys.content.replace(/\[\[\/?PACKS\]\]/g, '') };
  return { ...body, messages: sys ? [sys, ...rest] : rest };
}
// LLM_MODEL is tried first; if it is rate limited or down, models in LLM_FALLBACK_MODELS (comma separated) are tried next.
const RETRY = [413, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504];
app.post('/api/chat/completions', async (q, r) => {
  try {
    let body = slim(q.body || {});
    const vis = hasImg(body), bud = vis ? VBUDGET : BUDGET;
    body = fit(body, bud);
    const models = vis ? [VISION] : [E.LLM_MODEL, ...String(E.LLM_FALLBACK_MODELS || '').split(',').map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean)];
    let extra = vis ? { reasoning_format: 'hidden' } : {};   // keep the model's private thinking out of the answer
    let good = null, first = null, last = 0;
    for (const model of models) {
      for (let t = 0; t < 3; t++) {
        const u = await fetch(BASE.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/chat/completions', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + E.LLM_KEY },
          body: JSON.stringify({ ...body, ...extra, model, stream: body.stream !== false })
        });
        if (u.ok) { good = u; break; }
        const text = await u.text();
        if (!first) first = { status: u.status, type: u.headers.get('content-type'), text };
        last = u.status;
        if (u.status === 400 && Object.keys(extra).length) { extra = {}; continue; }   // model refused the extra option: retry plain
        if (u.status === 413 && t < 2) { body = fit(body, Math.floor(bud * 0.55)); continue; }
        break;
      }
      if (good) break;
      if (model === models[0] && !RETRY.includes(last)) break;
    }
    if (!good) return r.status(first.status).set('Content-Type', first.type || 'application/json').send(first.text);
    r.status(good.status).set('Content-Type', good.headers.get('content-type') || 'text/event-stream');
    for await (const c of good.body) r.write(c);
    r.end();
  } catch (e) { if (!r.headersSent) r.status(502).json({ error: 'Provider unreachable' }); else r.end(); }
});

app.post('/api/search', async (q, r) => {
  if (!E.TAVILY_KEY) return r.status(404).end();
  try {
    const u = await fetch('https://api.tavily.com/search', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + E.TAVILY_KEY },
      body: JSON.stringify({ query: String(q.body.q || '').slice(0, 300), max_results: 5 })
    });
    const j = await u.json();
    r.json({ results: (j.results || []).map(x => ({ title: x.title, url: x.url, content: String(x.content || '').slice(0, 600) })) });
  } catch (e) { r.status(502).json({ error: 'Search failed' }); }
});

app.post('/api/image', async (q, r) => {
  const body = q.body || {}, prompt = String(body.prompt || '').slice(0, 1000);
  if (!prompt) return r.status(400).json({ error: 'No prompt' });
  if (E.IMAGE_KEY && E.IMAGE_MODEL) {
    try {
      const u = await fetch((E.IMAGE_BASE || 'https://api.openai.com/v1').replace(/\/$/, '') + '/images/generations', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + E.IMAGE_KEY },
        body: JSON.stringify({ model: E.IMAGE_MODEL, prompt, size: '1024x1024', response_format: 'b64_json' })
      });
      const j = await u.json();
      const b = j.data && j.data[0] && j.data[0].b64_json;
      if (!u.ok || !b) return r.status(u.status || 502).json({ error: 'Image failed' });
      return r.json({ image: 'data:image/png;base64,' + b });
    } catch (e) { return r.status(502).json({ error: 'Image failed' }); }
  }
  if (E.IMAGE_OFF) return r.status(404).end();
  // Free image service (Pollinations). A free key in POLLI_KEY makes it more reliable.
  const w = Math.min(1536, Number(body.width) || 1024), h = Math.min(1536, Number(body.height) || 1024), seed = Number(body.seed) || Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e9);
  const qs = 'width=' + w + '&height=' + h + '&seed=' + seed + '&nologo=true&safe=true&enhance=false' + (E.POLLI_KEY ? '&key=' + encodeURIComponent(E.POLLI_KEY) : '');
  const tries = [['https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/', 'flux'], ['https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/', 'flux'], ['https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/', 'turbo']];
  let last = 502;
  for (const [host, model] of tries) {
    try {
      const u = await fetch(host + encodeURIComponent(prompt) + '?' + qs + '&model=' + model, { headers: E.POLLI_KEY ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + E.POLLI_KEY } : {}, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000) });
      const type = String(u.headers.get('content-type') || '').split(';')[0];
      if (u.ok && /^image\//.test(type)) {
        const buf = Buffer.from(await u.arrayBuffer());
        if (buf.length > 1000) return r.json({ image: 'data:' + type + ';base64,' + buf.toString('base64') });
      }
      last = u.status;
    } catch (e) { last = 504; }
  }
  r.status(last === 401 || last === 402 || last === 403 ? 401 : 502).json({ error: 'Image service unavailable' });
});

// Home-screen install (PWA): manifest and icons are served from here.
const ICONS = { 192: Buffer.from('', 'base64'), 512: Buffer.from('', 'base64') };
app.get('/manifest.webmanifest', (q, r) => r.set('Content-Type', 'application/manifest+json').send(JSON.stringify({
  name: 'Nova AI', short_name: 'Nova AI', start_url: '/', display: 'standalone', background_color: '#120d1b', theme_color: '#120d1b',
  icons: [192, 512].map(n => ({ src: '/icons/icon-' + n + '.png', sizes: n + 'x' + n, type: 'image/png', purpose: 'any' }))
})));
app.get(['/icons/icon-192.png', '/icons/icon-512.png'], (q, r) => r.set('Content-Type', 'image/png').send(ICONS[q.path.includes('512') ? 512 : 192]));
app.get('/sw.js', (q, r) => r.set('Content-Type', 'application/javascript').send("self.addEventListener('install',()=>self.skipWaiting());self.addEventListener('activate',e=>e.waitUntil(self.clients.claim()));self.addEventListener('fetch',()=>{});"));
app.get('/', (q, r) => r.sendFile(path.join(__dirname, 'index.html')));
app.listen(E.PORT || 3000, () => console.log('Nova AI running on port ' + (E.PORT || 3000)));
